plan.title: Address CodeRabbit findings on merged PR #4667: register messageRows test in CI subset, gate citations on a mounted composer
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Two CodeRabbit findings on merged PR #4667 are unaddressed on main: messageRows.test.tsx (which holds PAN-4642's cite-row and data-cited tests) is not in the root package.json test:frontend-subset so CI never runs it; and ConversationPanel.tsx passes citationsEnabled={!hideComposer}, so the Cite toolbar appears for resumable ended conversations, vault copies, cleared conversations, and forking conversations where no composer is mounted to show the resulting citation chip.
narratives.Proposal: Append messageRows.test.tsx to test:frontend-subset. Replace the citationsEnabled expression with CodeRabbit's one-line mirror of the ComposerFooter branch condition (!hideComposer && !onResume && !isForking && !conversation.clearedToConvId && conversation.origin !== 'vault'), keeping ConversationPanel.tsx at 1521 lines under its 1531 cap, and cover resume-bar, vault, and mounted-composer cases in ConversationPanel.test.tsx via the existing timelineMock.props capture. Document the gate in features/conversations.mdx and docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Fixing the merge-before-late-review race (PAN-4671)
- Registering other unlisted frontend tests such as messagesTimeline/dividers.test.tsx
- Clearing citations already saved in localStorage for ended or vault conversations
- Changing MessagesTimeline, CiteSelectionToolbar, or ComposerFooter behavior
- Refactoring the footer ternary chain or adding a composerMounted helper constant
- Raising the file-size allowlist cap for ConversationPanel.tsx

autoDecisions.summary: Gate citations on all four non-composer footer states (onResume, vault, isForking, clearedToConvId), not only the two the issue AC names
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue title asks to gate on a mounted composer; CodeRabbit's proposed one-liner is exactly the ComposerFooter branch condition. The AC's two cases are the minimum tested set.
ConversationPanel.tsx is a god file at 1521 of 1531 allowed lines; a helper adds lines and does not simplify the footer ternary, which chooses between different footers.

autoDecisions.summary: Add the gate tests to the existing ConversationPanel.test.tsx
autoDecisions.rationale: It is already in the CI subset and already captures MessagesTimeline props via timelineMock and has resume/ended fixtures, so no new subset entry is needed.

narrative.Action: In ConversationPanel.tsx line 1471 replace `citationsEnabled={!hideComposer}` with `citationsEnabled={!hideComposer && !onResume && !isForking && !conversation.clearedToConvId && conversation.origin !== 'vault'}` — one line, no new constant, no new import (file-size cap 1531, file is 1521). Then in __tests__/ConversationPanel.test.tsx add describe('ConversationPanel citation gate (PAN-4681)') after the 'resume message control' block, copying its beforeEach/afterEach shape, using a workLog-only messages fixture (like resumeMessagesData) and reading timelineMock.props.mock.calls.at(-1)?.[0]. Three tests: (1) ended conversation (sessionAlive false) → await 'Resume Session' button → citationsEnabled false; (2) { ...mockConversation, origin: 'vault' } → await composer-footer testid → citationsEnabled false; (3) active conversation (sessionAlive true, status 'active', endedAt null) → composer-footer present, no Resume Session button, citationsEnabled true. Exact fixtures in PRD WI-2.
